note: v1, written: NEVER ARRIVES. Rolling hypnotic minimal house (the style board's t16 row), 123 -> 122 bpm (the ramp in the last 32 bars), G minor (6A). 5:46. The featured illusion is THE ENDLESS FILTER (barber-pole): a 16th chord pulse runs through three parallel band-passes whose cutoffs climb five octaves on staggered saws while their levels swell in at the bottom and fade at the top. It's a Shepard tone made of a filter sweep: the house build itself rises for ever and never arrives, the tension of a build without its drop, in the tape's comedown. Its cycle is 16 bars in the build and the break (alone there), 8 in A, 4 in A2 and B; in B2 it stops for eight bars (the groove and the falling stair alone) and resumes. A rolling 16th sub on THE STAIR's degrees under Gm9 - Ebmaj7 - Cm9 - D7sus(b9), pumped from the kick, with phantom harmonics; ticking hats through a 5-bar high-pass LFO; syncopated rims. A2 hardens the kick and doubles the clap with a snare; B2 drops the sub for four bars and returns with octaves. Seams per the mix plan: in over a held G1 (t15's outro at 123), out over a held D2 into t17 at 122. Master: -11.0 LUFS, true peak -1.29 dBTP, levels 100 (pinned runs 2-3; fast compressor -16 dB/0.3 ms before the loudness stage). compscore seeds 0/11/19/29: 95.043/94.364/94.332/94.719.
